testCases.title: Verify Search Input Field Presence and Focus
testCases.description: Ensure that the Google search input field is visible and properly focused upon page load.
preconditions: User has navigated to www.google.com
Browser window is maximized
steps: Open browser and navigate to www.google.com
Check for the presence of the central search input box
testCases.expectedResult: The Google logo, search input field, and primary search buttons are visible, and the cursor is focused in the search input box.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Perform Basic Keyword Search
testCases.description: Verify that a user can enter a search query and successfully navigate to the search results page.
preconditions: User is on the Google home page
steps: Click on the search input field
Press 'Enter' or click the 'Google Search' button
testCases.expectedResult: The browser navigates to the search results page displaying relevant organic links, snippets, and images matching the query.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Verify 'I'm Feeling Lucky' Button Functionality
testCases.description: Ensure that clicking the 'I'm Feeling Lucky' button redirects the user directly to the first matching search result.
preconditions: User is on the Google home page
steps: Enter 'Doodle' into the search input field
testCases.expectedResult: The user bypasses the search results page and is redirected directly to the Google Doodles archive page.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Verify Search Autocomplete / Suggestions
testCases.description: Check that typing in the search box triggers real-time query suggestions dropdown.
preconditions: User is on the Google home page
steps: Type 'Weather in' slowly into the search input box
Wait for a brief moment for suggestions to appear
testCases.expectedResult: A dropdown list appears below the search box offering relevant autocomplete suggestions based on the typed text.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Verify Navigation to Sign In Page
testCases.description: Ensure the user can navigate to the Google authentication page via the Sign In button.
preconditions: User is on the Google home page
User is currently signed out
steps: Locate the 'Sign in' button in the top right corner of the page
testCases.expectedResult: The browser redirects to the Google Account login page (accounts.google.com) prompting for an email or phone number.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Verify Footer Links and Settings Navigation
testCases.description: Check that footer links such as About, Advertising, Business, How Search works, Privacy, and Terms are functional and accessible.
preconditions: User is on the Google home page
steps: Scroll down to the footer section of the page
testCases.expectedResult: The browser navigates successfully to the Google Privacy & Terms policy page.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
testCases.description: Verify that a user can successfully log into the OrangeHRM application using valid administrator credentials.
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
Valid username and password are available
steps: Enter valid username in the Username field
Enter valid password in the Password field
testCases.expectedResult: User is successfully logged in and redirected to the OrangeHRM dashboard page.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Unsuccessful Login with Invalid Credentials
testCases.description: Verify that the application displays an appropriate error message when an invalid password is provided.
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
steps: Enter valid username in the Username field
Enter invalid password in the Password field
testCases.expectedResult: User remains on the login page and an 'Invalid credentials' error message is displayed.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Login Validation with Empty Fields
testCases.description: Verify that validation messages appear when trying to log in with empty username and password fields.
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
steps: Leave Username and Password fields empty
testCases.expectedResult: Required field validation messages are displayed under both the Username and Password input fields.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Password Reset Navigation
testCases.description: Verify that clicking 'Forgot your password?' link navigates the user to the reset password request page.
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
steps: Click on the 'Forgot your password?' link
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to the Reset Password page containing the username input field.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Verify Login Page Elements Render Correctly
testCases.description: Ensure all core UI elements including logo, username field, password field, and login button are visible and properly aligned.
preconditions: User has network access to the application URL
testCases.expectedResult: OrangeHRM logo, Username field, Password field, and Login button are fully visible and correctly rendered.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Verify Field Validation for Empty Credentials

testCases.title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
testCases.description: Verify that a user can successfully log in using valid username and password credentials on the OrangeHRM login page.
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page (https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login)
Valid user credentials exist in the system
steps: Navigate to the OrangeHRM login URL
Enter a valid username in the username field
Enter a valid password in the password field
testCases.expectedResult: User is authenticated successfully and redirected to the dashboard page.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Unsuccessful Login with Invalid Credentials
testCases.description: Verify that the system displays an appropriate error message when a user attempts to log in with invalid credentials.
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
steps: Navigate to the OrangeHRM login URL
testCases.expectedResult: User remains on the login page and an 'Invalid credentials' error message is displayed.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Validation for Empty Fields on Login Page
testCases.description: Verify that validation messages appear when the user attempts to log in without entering a username and password.
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
steps: Navigate to the OrangeHRM login URL
Leave username and password fields blank
testCases.expectedResult: Inline validation messages 'Required' are displayed under both the username and password fields.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Forgot Password Link Navigation
testCases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Forgot your password?' link navigates the user to the password reset request page.
preconditions: User is on the OrangeHRM login page
steps: Navigate to the OrangeHRM login URL
Click on the 'Forgot your password?' link
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to the Reset Password page and can see the username input field.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow

testCases.title: Verify Login Page Elements and Branding
testCases.description: Verify that all essential UI components including branding, input fields, and login button are properly rendered on the page.
preconditions: User has network access to the application URL
testCases.expectedResult: OrangeHRM logo, username field, password field, login button, and social media/footer links are visible and properly aligned.
testCases.sourceRequirement: User can complete the primary workflow
